landing.eyebrow: Home & office cleaning in Dar es Salaam
landing.heroSubtitle: Choose your service and schedule. {{brand}} handles the rest — a verified cleaner arrives with their own equipment, at a fixed price.
landing.servicesSubtitle: Clear prices before you book. No haggling, no surprises.
landing.howSubtitle: Book in a couple of minutes. We take it from there.

choose.title: Choose your service
choose.body: Tell us what needs cleaning, the size of your home and any extras.

schedule.title: Pick a date and time
schedule.body: Select a time that suits you. You see the full price immediately.

assign.title: We assign a verified cleaner
assign.body: We match you with an available, vetted cleaner who covers your area.

relax.title: Relax — we clean
relax.body: Follow progress in real time, pay in cash afterwards and rate the service.

verified.title: Every provider is verified
verified.body: We check identity, references and experience before anyone receives a job.

equipment.title: Equipment & materials included
equipment.body: Cleaners arrive with their own supplies and tools. You don't need to buy anything.

pricing.title: Fixed prices, set by us
pricing.body: The price you see is the price you pay. Cleaners never renegotiate at your door.

support.title: Someone to call
support.body: If anything isn't right, report it in the app and our team will follow up.

landing.providersTitle: Individual cleaners and trusted cleaning companies
landing.providersBody: Our network includes experienced independent cleaners and registered cleaning companies with trained teams. You don't need to choose — we assign the right one for your booking based on availability, location and quality.
landing.areasSubtitle: Currently serving these neighbourhoods in Dar es Salaam, with more coming soon.
landing.providerCtaTitle: Are you a cleaner or a cleaning company?
landing.providerCtaBody: Get steady jobs near you without spending on marketing. Set your own working days and areas — we bring the customers.

faq.q: Do I need to provide cleaning materials?
faq.a: No. Every cleaner brings their own materials and equipment. Just make sure there is water and electricity available.
Prices are fixed by us based on the service, the size of your home and any extras you choose. You see the full price before you confirm.
We assign a verified cleaner who serves your area and is available at your chosen time. You can see who is coming as soon as they accept.
Pay in cash to the cleaner once the job is complete. Mobile money and card payments are coming soon.

faq.q: What if I'm not happy with the cleaning?
faq.a: Report an issue from your booking before confirming completion. Our team reviews every report and will make it right.

landing.footerTagline: Professional cleaning for homes and offices in Dar es Salaam.

howPage.title: How it works
howPage.subtitle: Book. We assign. We clean.
after: We confirm your booking instantly and start finding a cleaner.
A verified cleaner who covers your area accepts the job — you'll see their name and rating.
Follow each step: on the way, arrived, cleaning in progress, completed.
Check the work, confirm completion and pay the cleaner in cash.
Rate the service so we keep quality high.

helpPage.subtitle: We're here to help with bookings, payments and anything else.
helpPage.issueBody: Open the booking in your account and choose "Report an issue". This gets to our operations team fastest.
